settings.data.exportDesc: Gcina izilinganiso, isimo sokufunda, okubhaliselwe namaqoqo efayeleni le-JSON.

settings.data.resetDesc: Susa izilinganiso, umlando wokufunda, okubhaliselwe, namaqoqo. Akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
settings.data.importError: Ayikwazi ukufunda ifayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi yifayela lesipele elivumelekile.
settings.account.title: Ukuphathwa kwe-akhawunti · ukushiya isevisi
settings.account.desc: Ukuhlela iphrofayela nokususa i-akhawunti kungenziwa ekhasini lakho lephrofayela. Uma ususa i-akhawunti, ulwazi lwakho lokungena luyasuswa futhi iseshini iphelelwe yisikhathi.
